members.title: fix(shared): preserve MCPError payload on pickle
members.author: MukundaKatta
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2555: Python's default `Exception.__reduce_ex__` rebuilds exceptions with `cls(*self.args)`, but `MCPError.__init__` sets `self.args = (code, message, data)` — a 3-tuple that doesn't match `UrlElicitationRequiredError.__init__(elicitations, message=None)`. Both PRs fix this pickle round-trip failure in `src/mcp/shared/exceptions.py`.
